_note: Seed candidates per Scout (one Scout per material family). Names match data/calibration/tier1.json so trust-tier results find their measured values. structure_source follows docs/simulation-requests.md: ase:/file: sources go to the ALCHEMI Simulator; 'pubchem:<CID>' is an identifier for the classical-MD route only (not runnable by ALCHEMI). Candidates with no route are still posted (so the board shows the gap) but request nothing. Melting-point brackets are centred on the literature value (t_guess from tier1.json); two-phase coexistence decides the answer. Budgets are per-Scout caps on candidates, pending the GB10 throughput decision.

candidates.name: Cu
candidates.rationale: method validation: well-measured metal, MACE-MPA-0 in domain

candidates.name: Al
candidates.rationale: method validation: second well-measured fcc metal

candidates.name: Ga
candidates.rationale: low-melting metal PCM candidate (melts near 303 K); needs a periodic alpha-Ga cell in data/structures/

candidates.name: In
candidates.rationale: low-melting metal, high conductivity; needs a periodic tetragonal In cell in data/structures/

candidates.name: n-eicosane
candidates.rationale: flight-heritage paraffin class; MACE-MP is out of domain for molecular crystals, so classical MD

candidates.name: n-octadecane
candidates.rationale: the default paraffin PCM baseline to beat

candidates.name: n-hexadecane
candidates.rationale: shorter paraffin; brackets the chain-length trend

candidates.name: lauric acid
candidates.rationale: fatty-acid PCM in the 300-360 K range

candidates.name: stearic acid
candidates.rationale: fatty-acid PCM near the top of the candidate window

candidates.name: erythritol
candidates.rationale: high latent heat per kg (~320 kJ/kg) but melts near 391 K

candidates.name: xylitol
candidates.rationale: sugar alcohol melting near 366 K; strong supercooling is a known issue; no structure yet

candidates.name: calcium chloride hexahydrate
candidates.rationale: cheap high-density salt hydrate near 302 K; needs a periodic cell in data/structures/

candidates.name: sodium sulfate decahydrate
candidates.rationale: Glauber's salt; melts incongruently, a stability risk to flag

scout_plastic_crystal._note: Solid-solid PCMs: inclusion is an open team decision (CLAUDE.md section 14.1). Disabled until the chemistry lead approves.

candidates.name: neopentyl glycol
candidates.rationale: solid-solid transition near 315 K: no liquid to contain in microgravity
